components.name: Popover
components.description:
Popover/Default composition. It mirrors the exported Figma structure while
keeping the item list composable for Select, Autocomplete, and menu fields.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the surface is shown. Default false: pass `open` (controlled, with `onOpenChange`) to show it.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label above the options (Figma .Primitives/Popover/Label, for example `Component Size`), not the current selection. It names
 the option list (aria-labelledby); it is a label, not a heading, so a popover never adds to the page outline.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the option list (role=listbox) when there is no visible `label`, e.g. "Sort by".

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: id of the element that names the option list (role=listbox); wins over `label` and `aria-label`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the Search row. Default: the locale's "Search".

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when the (filtered) item list is empty. Default: the locale's "No results"; `null` shows nothing.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Move focus into the popover when it opens (use when it was opened from the keyboard).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` on a pointer-down outside the popover (and outside `anchorRef`) or on Escape.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The trigger element; pointer-downs on it are left to the trigger's own toggle.

props.name: searchClearable
props.description: Show the Search clear button while it has a value (Figma Search/Popover Typing/Inputted).

props.name: align
props.description: Preferred horizontal edge against the anchor box; flips when it would overflow the viewport.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select list: every item gets a trailing Checkbox/Mark (Figma multi-select Popover).

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the label: an icon name (`"icon-folder-line"`, drawn at 20px) or any node.

props.name: trailing
props.description: After the label: an icon name (drawn at 16px) or any node (a Badge, a shortcut).

props.name: state
props.description: Static preview of Figma's Hover state (real hover/focus work without it).

props.name: control
props.description:
`checkbox`: multi-select row — a trailing Checkbox/Mark shows the selection instead of the
Single-Selected fill + check icon.

props.name: itemRole
props.description:
ARIA role of the row. `option` (default) in a listbox, with aria-selected from `selected`; `menuitem` in a Menu (no
aria-selected); `menuitemcheckbox` / `menuitemradio` for a checkable menu row, with aria-checked from `selected`.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the options (names the option list; not a heading). Default: the locale's "Select an option or create one".

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Text of the create row, before the Badge with the typed value. Default: the locale's "Create".
